shape.brief: matches on the file (anchor stripped both sides); notices/contracts/memory/task paths may carry anchors
edit_window_protocol: read and prepare without a claim
claim the hub file with wait_secs
re-read if waited, write once, run quickest check
shape.implementation_sketch: anchor inside RepoPath's stored string; RepoPath::file(), anchor(); overlaps anchor-aware; is_ancestor_of path-only; covers(held,p) for renew/absorb; brief uses file()

naming_guidance.discover: Serena get_symbols_overview / find_symbol name paths, LSP outline, grep -n
naming_guidance.imports_exports: import/use/mod lines and export-list entries (__all__, pub use, export {}) needed by a claimed symbol are covered by that claim; no append anchor
naming_guidance.new_member: claim by its new name: app/config.py#Config::gzip_min_size
naming_guidance.rename: claim old + new anchors and callers' files; notice kind rename

overlap.rule: paths overlap per ADR-0005, AND (either side unanchored OR paths differ OR one anchor's segments are a whole-segment prefix of the other's, ASCII case-insensitive)
overlap.used_by: claim conflicts, wait_secs retries, claims_list path filter, task_pull holds (ADR-0028)

own_claims.absorb: claiming f absorbs own f#X claims; claiming f#X absorbs own f#X::y
own_claims.release: exact as today, compared on the stored form; release with no paths frees all
own_claims.renew: a target covered by a path/anchor the agent already holds is renewed, not added

shape.schema_budget: no tools/list change; documented in 04-primitives.md and AGENTS.md

syntax.files_with_hash: a filename containing '#' cannot be claimed alone; claim its directory
syntax.invalid: empty path, empty anchor, empty segment (A::, ::b, a..b), whitespace inside a segment
syntax.path_part: normalized exactly like RepoPath::new; a raw path ending in '/' cannot carry an anchor (error)
syntax.separators: '::', '.', '/' all accepted; stored and echoed as '::' (app/config.py#Config.from_env -> app/config.py#Config::from_env)
syntax.split: at the FIRST '#'; later '#' belong to a segment (TS Counter.#count)
syntax.stripped: generic args <...> (Store<T>::load -> Store::load); Go receiver (*Server).Handle -> Server::Handle
syntax.target: path | path#Anchor inside existing claim `paths` strings; no new parameter

shape.validation: syntax only; the daemon never checks symbol existence
shape.wait_secs: identical to file claims; risk: file-claim waiter starving behind anchor claims -> FIFO waiting if measured

writing_rules.compiling_writes: each write leaves the file compiling/importable; do not fix another holder's symbol, message them
writing_rules.no_whole_file_rewrite: under an anchor claim edit by replacement; never Write/cat > a file other agents hold anchors in
writing_rules.serena_symbol_edits: untested for stale buffers; avoid on files with other anchor holders until the benchmark checks
